note.text: Every employee is quietly getting a different model: tuned to their phrasing, their shortcuts, their blind spots. That feels like progress until a meeting starts and five people arrive with five subtly different versions of the same fact. Shared context used to be the default cost of working together; now it has to be engineered on purpose, or it quietly disappears. The real infrastructure question isn't whose model is smartest, it's whose model everyone agreed to trust first.
